perf.summary: Align is correct for power-of-two alignment but has no overflow guard; for the unchecked-Run convention this is fine, otherwise note size+alignment-1 can overflow int.
perf.currentCost: (size + alignment - 1) & ~(alignment - 1): if size is near int.MaxValue the addition overflows and wraps to a negative/wrong value. No extra cycles spent, but correctness depends on caller staying in range.
perf.proposedChange: No code change recommended if this follows the unchecked-Run convention (assume valid input). If a checked variant is desired, document the precondition size <= int.MaxValue - alignment + 1 and that alignment must be a power of two, rather than adding a runtime branch on the hot path.
perf.rationale: The masking approach is already the optimal branchless power-of-two round-up (single add + and). No strength reduction or further simplification is possible; flagging only the overflow precondition for documentation.
perf.risk: None to behavior — this is a documentation/precondition note. Adding a guard would cost a branch on a hot inlined leaf, so it should NOT be added under the perf model.
